title: Camera settings
description: Record each run and crop what appears in your in-game camera.
permissionHint: Your camera stays on while the game is open. Video is saved only during runs.
unsupported: Camera recording is available on macOS and Windows.
captureLocked: Camera and recording quality can be changed after this recording finishes. Playback settings remain available.
captureError: The camera could not start. Check camera permission and your selected camera, then try again.
storageDescription: The maximum space for all saved camera videos. When full, the oldest videos are removed first.
retentionDescription: Videos older than this are automatically removed. The run and its replay stay in your history.
storageHint: Each recording is limited to 128 MB. Microphone audio is saved separately.
cropHint: Drag a corner to crop. Drag inside the frame to move the crop. Focus the frame or a corner and use the arrow keys for precise changes; hold Shift for larger steps. Changes save when you release.
cropRecordingHint: Cropping changes the live camera and replay display. The full camera image is still saved in recordings.

cropPreview.privacy: Click to allow browser camera access and show the preview. Check what is in view before sharing your screen.
cropPreview.off: Turn the camera on to preview and crop it.
cropPreview.waiting: Allow camera access in your browser to see the preview.
cropPreview.disconnected: Connect to the game to preview your camera.
cropPreview.failed: The camera preview stopped. Check browser camera permission and try again.
cropPreview.permission: Camera access is blocked. Allow camera access for this page in your browser, then try again.
cropPreview.notFound: The preview camera is unavailable. Reconnect the camera and try again.
cropPreview.inUse: The browser could not open the camera. Check whether another app is using it, then try again.
cropPreview.unsupported: This browser cannot access the camera here. Open this page using localhost or HTTPS in a browser with camera support.
cropPreview.deviceHint: The browser could not identify the game's camera. Choose the same camera to check your crop.

inGamePlacementHint: Move and resize the camera directly in the game. Drag the image to move it, or drag any edge or corner to resize. Changes are saved automatically.
syncHint: The first frame is automatically aligned with the replay clock. To correct camera latency, pause near a key press and compare the image with the replay. Positive values show the image earlier; negative values show it later.
ffmpegHint: Windows camera recording needs FFmpeg. Turn on the camera and approve installation in the web setup dialog. TUFReplay installs it for both recording and rendering.

errors.readSettings: Camera settings could not be read. Check the game connection and update TUFReplay if needed.
errors.invalid_webcam_settings: Check the camera setting values and try again.
errors.webcam_unavailable: Camera settings are unavailable. Restart the game and try again.
errors.webcam_settings_locked: Finish the current recording before changing the camera or recording quality.
errors.webcam_settings_failed: Camera settings could not be saved. Check available disk space and try again.
